method: MLX affine weight-only mixed precision, uncapped 30-generation follow-up
offspring_schedule: 16 new in generations 1-14 and 16-29; 17 new in generations 15 and 30; one elite retained each generation
resource_cap_note: The user removed the former v3 time and storage budgets on 2026-10-18. Large sentinel values only satisfy the inherited runner schema; the v3 supervisor cap is disabled.
byte_budget_rule: Exact total model parameter bytes at or below the conventional uniform-4 recipe, including quantization metadata arrays
data: Fresh AG News train indices 25000:30000, IMDb test indices 5000:10000, and 400 previously unused ARC-Challenge questions; calibration and validation frozen in v3/data_manifest.json
primary_outcome: Paired best validation NLL across 30 complete generations; final fresh held-out NLL and ARC accuracy for validation-selected choices
selection_rule: Three lowest train-NLL genomes per search plus shared informed and uniform-4 genomes are scored on validation; choose minimum validation NLL per arm and seed; choose deployable model by validation alone
supersedes: The interrupted 188-candidate search in ../wide_mlx_affine_qwen3_1_7b. Its partial training scores are excluded from this protocol and its fresh held-out set was not evaluated.
